fields.Name: Cash
fields.Description: Cash / bank account the money lands in (payment-time entries).

fields.Name: Accounts Receivable
fields.Description: The AR control account debited when a sale is booked before payment.

fields.Name: Inventory
fields.Description: Inventory asset account (deferred domain - seeded per AM-2 for completeness).

fields.Name: Cost of Goods Sold
fields.Description: COGS expense account (deferred domain - seeded per AM-2 for completeness).

fields.Name: Sales
fields.Description: Revenue account credited when a sale is recognized.

fields.Name: Sales Discounts
fields.Description: Contra-revenue account for discounts granted on sales.

fields.Name: Sales Returns and Allowances
fields.Description: Contra-revenue account for returned goods / allowances.

fields.Name: Deferred Revenue
fields.Description: Liability account credited for revenue not yet earned (subscriptions). ASSUMED addition (OQ-H): absent from the 07-03 seed list but required by the meeting's own subscription example - confirm with Amith.

fields.Name: Processing Fee
fields.Description: Payment processor fees expensed at capture (orders D18). The gateway keeps its cut, so cash lands NET while the customer's receivable is relieved GROSS; this role names the expense account carrying the difference. Without it the fee is not booked and cash reads gross by that amount.

fields.Name: BankAccount
fields.Description: Cash / bank GL account that counts toward the company's cash position. Many per company, date-effective. NOT used for payment posting — that is role Cash, which stays singular. Read by FP&A to build CashBalance as the sum of a company's Active BankAccount links at a point in time.
